transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support. My name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam. My name is Chloe Davenport. Our broadband has completely stopped working because our garden shears sliced right through the black fiber cable running along the fence!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good morning Chloe. I can certainly help you arrange an engineer repair for that severed fiber cable. Before we proceed, could you please confirm your full address and the account holder's date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, our address is 19 Primrose Way, Harrogate, HG2 9PB, and my date of birth is the fourteenth of July 1989. We have a white Nokia ONT box mounted on the hallway wall.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Chloe, that successfully verifies your account. Could you describe what happened to the cable outside?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My husband was trimming the ivy along the back fence with heavy shears, and he accidentally cut straight through the black wire clipped along the timber! The two ends are completely severed and hanging down! I run my graphic design business from home and I am in total panic because I have a major deadline tomorrow!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how stressful that is, Chloe, especially when you have client deadlines depending on your home internet. Don't worry, we deal with accidental cable cuts regularly and we will get an Openreach engineer booked to splice a new lead-in for you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, that is very reassuring. My best contact mobile number is 07700 900341.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What lights are currently showing on your indoor optical fiber box on the hallway wall?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The power light is steady green, but the LOS light is flashing bright red, and the PON light is completely off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The flashing red LOS light confirms Loss of Signal, meaning the optical light beam cannot reach your unit from the exchange.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we twist the optical fibers back together or tape them with insulating tape as a temporary fix?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please do not touch the severed ends. Fiber optic cables transmit invisible laser light that can cause permanent eye injury, and the glass core requires professional fusion splicing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good goodness, I will tell my husband not to touch it at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to make sure I have captured everything accurately, Chloe, garden shears severed the external black fiber drop cable along your boundary fence, the indoor box shows a red LOS light, and we need an emergency fiber engineer dispatch to replace the external drop cable, is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly right Liam. We need someone out here as soon as humanly possible.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please hold for two or three minutes while I check the Openreach engineer scheduling portal for available emergency repair appointments in Harrogate.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I will hold.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Chloe. I have opened an emergency external damage ticket. Before booking, please note that because the physical cut occurred inside your property boundary, Openreach may classify this as accidental customer damage carrying a ninety-pound standard callout fee.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Ninety pounds?! Are you serious?! We've been paying sixty pounds a month for top-tier gigabit broadband for three years without a single late payment! That fee is completely outrageous and unfair when an honest garden accident happens! I cannot afford ninety pounds right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Those are standard industry terms. Physical damage caused by occupants or tools is always chargeable under section four of our broadband service agreement.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, fine, but I still need the internet fixed immediately for my work, so go ahead and book it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The earliest appointment Openreach offers is tomorrow morning between eight o'clock and one in the afternoon. Will an adult over eighteen be present at the address during that slot?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I will be home all day working offline on design sketches.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I confirm the appointment slot on our dispatch portal, let me verify that mobile telephone number for engineer SMS arrival alerts was 07700 900341, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 07700 900341 is my mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you tell me the make and model of the white optical box mounted on your hallway wall?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I mentioned right at the start of the call when I gave my address, it is a white Nokia ONT box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. The engineer notes have been populated with the Nokia unit details and the fence cable location.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the engineer need access inside the house, or just outside in the garden?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer will need access to both. They must pull a new outdoor drop cable along the boundary and test the optical signal levels at the indoor wall unit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. We will make sure the side wooden gate is unlocked and the hallway is clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Will someone be able to direct the engineer to where the cable enters the brickwork?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my husband will show him where the conduit runs under the eaves.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: In the meantime, while your fixed broadband is offline, would you like me to add a complimentary thirty-gigabyte emergency mobile data boost to your S-Net mobile SIM?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, wow, yes please! That will allow me to tether my laptop to my phone and send client files this evening!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have activated the complimentary thirty-gigabyte data boost right now. You should receive a text confirmation on your mobile phone within five minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is tremendously helpful Liam, thank you so much for arranging that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you check your smartphone right now to confirm whether the data allowance shows up on your screen?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! The notification just popped in saying thirty gigabytes bonus data added successfully.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now turn on your personal hotspot on your phone and try connecting your work laptop to make sure you can browse.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have turned hotspot on, my laptop has joined Chloe-iPhone, and Google loaded immediately!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! That ensures your graphic design work and file uploads will remain completely uninterrupted until tomorrow's repair.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That takes an immense amount of pressure off my shoulders. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Your Openreach repair booking reference is OR-884109. The engineer is scheduled for tomorrow between 8:00 AM and 1:00 PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have written that reference down: OR-884109 for tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The engineer will call you thirty minutes before arrival. Is there anything else I can assist you with regarding your broadband setup today, Chloe?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that covers everything. You have booked the visit and sorted out the backup data, which saves my work day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support, Chloe. We hope you enjoy the rest of your day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Liam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A brief two-question service survey will follow on your mobile phone. Have a wonderful afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, I will take the survey.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you again Chloe, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net broadband services.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, bye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.
